## Shared scenes

> [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) are shocked that an orphan girl named [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) was sent instead of a boy. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) breaks down in tears upon realizing she is unwanted, but she settles in for tea and is put to bed in the east gable room. Afterward, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) discuss what to do, with [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) insisting that [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) must be sent back to the asylum while [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) feels reluctant to do so.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised P0](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised P8](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised P39](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0039), [v1 CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised P52](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0052)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) wakes up at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) and marvels at the bright June morning outside her window, though she laments that her stay will likely be brief. During breakfast and while helping with household chores, she talks incessantly to a sharp yet increasingly fascinated [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), even bestowing names like [Frost Maiden](../codex/places.md#frost-maiden) on the cherry tree and Bonny on the geranium. Afterwards, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) takes [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) in the buggy to [Pale Sands](../codex/places.md#pale-sands-hotel) to meet Mrs. [Tranter](../character/tranter.md) and settle Nell's return to [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia), despite Obed's quiet desire to keep the girl.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER IV. Morning at Grey Shutters

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Grey Shutters P0](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Grey Shutters P14](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Grey Shutters P35](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Grey Shutters P40](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0040)_

> [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) visit Mrs. [Tranter](../character/tranter.md) to resolve the mix-up regarding the adopted child, encountering Mrs. [Scobie](../character/scobie.md) who offers to take [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md). Unwilling to leave the girl with Mrs. [Scobie](../character/scobie.md), [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) delays the decision and takes [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) back to [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), where she and [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) ultimately agree to keep her.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER VI. Thirza Makes Up Her Mind

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VI. Thirza Makes Up Her Mind P3](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Thirza Makes Up Her Mind P18](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Thirza Makes Up Her Mind P20](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0020), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Thirza Makes Up Her Mind P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031)_

> [Aunt Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) takes [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) up to bed and insists she fold her clothes and say her prayers. After learning [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) never prays, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) instructs her to improvise one, leading [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to offer a unique prayer before settling into bed. Downstairs in the kitchen, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) informs [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) of her determination to provide [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) with a proper religious upbringing.
>

> [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) informs [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) that she and [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) have decided to let her stay at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters). Excited and emotional, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) asks if she may call [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) her aunt, but [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) refuses and sends her to memorize the Lord's Prayer in her room.
>

> [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) scolds [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) for her constant talking and sends her to her room to finish memorizing a prayer. Upstairs, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) finishes learning the prayer, imagines luxurious decorations in her room, and greets her surroundings from the window while thinking about potential friendships.
>

> Mrs. Agatha Sowerby visits [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) and rudely mocks Nell's plain appearance and red hair. Enraged by the insult, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) flies into a violent temper and shouts at Mrs. Sowerby before storming off to her room. After Mrs. Sowerby leaves in offense, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) goes upstairs to lecture [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and demands that she apologize, though [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) stubbornly refuses.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Properly Horrified

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Properly Horrified P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Properly Horrified P30](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0030), [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Properly Horrified P45](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0045)_

> [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) secretly visits [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) in her room and convinces her to apologize to Mrs. Sowerby. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) agrees, and [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) accompanies her to Mrs. Sowerby's house, where [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) delivers a dramatic and humble apology. Mrs. Sowerby forgives her and offers her hope about her hair, and on the walk home, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) shares her imaginative thoughts with [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), expressing her joy at feeling at home at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters).
>

> [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) presents [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) with three simple dresses and refuses her request for fashionable puffed sleeves, sending her off to study Sunday school materials. The next morning, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) decorates her hat with flowers and attends Sunday school alone when [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) falls ill. Upon returning, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) candidly recounts her experiences at church, including her dislike of her plain dress compared to the other girls' puffed sleeves and her impression of the service.
>

> [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) reprimands [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) for wearing flowers on her hat to church, then takes her to [Pear Hill](../codex/places.md#pear-hill) where [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) meets [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md). The two young girls quickly bond and swear to be best friends forever before [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns home. Back at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) gives [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) chocolates, and [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) admits to him that she is growing fond of the girl.
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns home late after visiting Isolde and [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md), excitedly sharing news with [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) about an upcoming Sunday-school picnic. While stitching patchwork, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) chats endlessly about her imaginative games, and over the weekend she continues her eager anticipation of the picnic and admires Thirza's cherished amethyst brooch.
>

> [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) accuses [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) of taking her missing amethyst brooch and locks her in her room after [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) insists she didn't touch it. Desperate to attend the upcoming picnic, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) eventually fabricates a confession about dropping the brooch into the lake, but [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) forbids her from going anyway. Later, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) discovers the brooch caught in her own lace shawl and confronts [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) about her fake story.
>

> [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) discovers her missing amethyst brooch tangled in her black lace shawl and realizes [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) was innocent after all. She confronts [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), who admits she invented a false confession just so she could go to the picnic. Remorseful, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) forgives [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and sends her off to the picnic, where [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) enjoys tea, ice cream, and a boat ride on the lake.
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde walk to [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) school together while discussing their schoolmates and their beautiful surroundings. During afternoon classes, [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) teases [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) by calling her 'Carrots' and pulling her hair, prompting an enraged [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to smash her slate over his head.
>

> In class, [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) teases [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) about her red hair, prompting her to smash her slate over his head in anger. Mr. [Pidgeon](../character/pidgeon.md) punishes [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) by forcing her to stand at the front of the room and later making her sit beside Hugh, leading [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to declare that she will never return to school. Upon returning home, [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) seeks advice from [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), who recommends letting [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) rest at home until her temper subsides.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P34](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0034), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089)_

> Following Agatha's advice, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) decides not to force [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) back to school, allowing her to study at home instead. Though [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) stubbornly refuses to forgive [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), she grows deeply attached to Isolde. [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) later finds [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) weeping dramatically over the imagined future heartbreak of Isolde marrying and leaving her, which moves [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) to rare, genuine laughter.
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) gets permission from [Aunt Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) to host Isolde for an afternoon tea while [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) is away in [Delford](../codex/places.md#delford). When Isolde arrives, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) serves her several glasses of what she believes to be raspberry cordial. Isolde becomes dizzy and ill from the drink, forcing her to leave prematurely before they can even have tea.
>

> Isolde leaves [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) unwell, and [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) later discovers [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) mistakenly served three-year-old currant wine instead of raspberry cordial. After learning Mrs. [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md) blames [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) for getting Isolde drunk, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) visits [Pear Hill](../codex/places.md#pear-hill) to clear up the mistake but is rebuffed. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) then confronts Mrs. [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md) herself to beg for forgiveness, but Mrs. [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md) coldly turns her away.
>

> While [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and Mrs. Sowerby attend a political rally in town, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) spend a quiet evening at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters). [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md) rushes in to ask for help when her baby sister, [Posy Fay](../character/posy-fay.md), contracts croup while their parents are away. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) uses her experience to treat [Posy Fay](../character/posy-fay.md) through the night until a doctor arrives, saving the child's life before returning home to rest.
>

> After sleeping off her exhaustion, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) learns from [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) that Mrs. [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md) apologized for the past misunderstanding and invited her over. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) excitedly rushes to visit Isolde, and upon returning home, she joyfully recounts their reconciled friendship and wonderful afternoon together.

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) convinces [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) to let her stay at Isolde's and go to the [Debating Club](../codex/factions.md#debating-club) concert. After enjoying the concert and performances, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde return to the [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md) home late at night, where they inadvertently jump into bed on top of Isolde's visiting [Aunt Lavinia](../character/aunt-lavinia.md).
>

> After learning that [Aunt Lavinia](../character/aunt-lavinia.md) [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md) was furious over the bed-jumping incident and planned to leave, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) takes full responsibility for the prank. She goes into the parlor to apologize directly to [Aunt Lavinia](../character/aunt-lavinia.md), successfully winning over the strict old woman with her honesty and charm. [Aunt Lavinia](../character/aunt-lavinia.md) decides to stay, forgives Isolde, and develops a fond friendship with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md).
>

> In her room at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) reflects on her first year with [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), who admits she does not regret keeping her. When [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) asks her to fetch an apron pattern from the [Pembrokes](../character/pembroke.md), [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) confesses that she and Isolde invented ghosts in the nearby wood, making her terrified to cross it in the dark. Unmoved, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) forces [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to walk through the woods to teach her a lesson, and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) reluctantly completes the frightening errand.
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns home on the last day of school, emotional over Mr. Pidgeon's departure and discussing the upcoming arrival of the new clergyman, Mr. [Wace](../character/wace.md), and his wife. She later discusses the church's new leadership, her Sunday school experiences, and her excitement about baking a cake for the new minister's visit, which she practices for while spending time with Isolde by the Nymph's Well.
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) prepares a cake and sets an elaborate table for a tea party with the minister and his wife, enticing [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) to attend as well. However, because a severe cold ruined her sense of smell, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) accidentally flavored the cake with liniment instead of vanilla. Distraught, she flees to her room, but Mrs. [Wace](../character/wace.md) gently comforts her and accompanies her to see her flower garden.
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) receives an invitation to tea at the manse from Mrs. [Wace](../character/wace.md), which excites her greatly despite Thirza's attempts to temper her emotions. After attending tea with another girl named [Lauretta](../character/lauretta.md) Bradley, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) joyfully reports back to [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) about her wonderful evening, Mrs. Wace's kindness, and news that a female teacher named Miss Agnes [Thorne](../character/thorne.md) has been hired for the local school.
>

> At a party hosted by [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) accepts a dare from [Flossie Tulk](../character/flossie-tulk.md) to walk across the kitchen roof's ridgepole. She slips and falls, breaking her ankle in the process. Mr. [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md) carries her home to [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) spends the next seven weeks recovering in bed while friends, neighbors, and local figures visit her.
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns to school under the guidance of her new teacher, Miss [Thorne](../character/thorne.md), and excitedly shares her academic achievements and upcoming school concert plans with [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md). While [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) remains skeptical of the concert and physical activities, [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) offers [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) his steady support and encouragement.

> [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) notices how poorly [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) dresses compared to her friends and decides to buy her a stylish new gown for [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas). After an awkward attempt to shop by himself at [Samuel](../character/samuel.md) Lawson's store in [Delford](../codex/places.md#delford), he enlists Mrs. Sowerby's help to buy the fabric and sew the dress with fashionable puffed sleeves. On [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) morning, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) receives the gown at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) and is overwhelmed with joy and gratitude.
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) is overjoyed by [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) gifts, including a new dress from [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) and slippers from Isolde's family. Later that night, following a successful [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) school concert, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde discuss the evening's performances on their way home. Meanwhile, [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) and [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) privately express their pride in Nell's performance and discuss her future education.

> Following the excitement of the school concert, routine resumes at [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) while [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde discuss turning thirteen and working on school essays along the [Aspen Path](../codex/places.md#aspen-path). [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) shares a dramatic story she wrote for Miss Thorne's assignment, inspiring the creation of a private story club with Isolde and other girls. When [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) discusses the club's creative endeavors with [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) dismisses the story writing as foolish and harmful to her studies.
>

> [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) returns to [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) expecting tea, only to find the kitchen cold and empty. She discovers [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) hiding in her room, distraught because she dyed her red hair green with a peddler's dye. After washing fails to remove the dye, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) cuts Nell's hair extremely short, and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) must face school with her cropped head.

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) meets [Odette](../character/odette-pullen.md) and Isolde, who are relieved to find her alive after thinking she drowned during their reenactment. Later, back at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) reflects on her past mistakes and vows to give up her excessive romanticism, though [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) quietly encourages her to keep a little of it.
>

> Isolde informs [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) of an invitation from [Aunt Lavinia](../character/aunt-lavinia.md) to visit her in town for the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition). After [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) consents, Mr. [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md) drives the girls to [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood), Aunt Lavinia's home, where [Miss Pembroke](../character/miss-pembroke.md) welcomes them warmly. The girls spend the week taking in the town's attractions, including attending the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition) and a concert.
>

> After enjoying a concert and a ice cream outing in the city, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde are picked up by Mr. [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md) to return home. [Aunt Lavinia](../character/aunt-lavinia.md) bids them a fond farewell, reflecting warmly on Nell's sweet nature. Arriving back at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) warmly greets [Aunt Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md), happy to be home.
>

> At [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) tells [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) that Miss [Thorne](../character/thorne.md) offered to include her in a special class to prepare for the Regent's entrance exam. Excited by the chance to train as a teacher, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) accepts and joins the class alongside her peers, though she mourns that Isolde will not be participating with her.

> At school, Hugh silently competes with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) while ignoring her, leaving her to regret her past harshness as the term ends. Miss [Thorne](../character/thorne.md) reassures the class that she will return next year, prompting [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to happily lock away her books for summer vacation. Later, [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) visits [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) and compliments Nell's growth and grace despite her initial misgivings.

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) enjoys a relaxing, healthy summer after a doctor advises outdoor play to preserve her health. Returning to her studies in autumn, she works hard under Miss Thorne's guidance to prepare for the upcoming Entrance examination despite her growing anxieties. As she physically matures and reflects on her changes, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) experiences a bittersweet realization of [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) growing up.
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) prepares for her departure to Regent's [Academy](../codex/places.md#regent-s-academy), sharing an emotional goodbye with [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters). After arriving in town, she adjusts to her new surroundings and classes alongside students like [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) and [Flossie Tulk](../character/flossie-tulk.md). Upon hearing news of an upcoming [Avery](../codex/places.md#avery) scholarship, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) sets her sights on winning it to pursue a college degree.
>

> [Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md) collapses and dies after receiving news of the bank failure, plunging [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) into mourning. Later, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) grieves with [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and converses with Mrs. [Wace](../character/wace.md) about life carrying on despite her loss. As routine returns, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) chat on the porch about friends, future plans, and Thirza's past romance.
>

> [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) returns from the eye doctor with bad news that her vision is severely failing and she must avoid eye strain, prompting her to consider selling [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters). [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) insists on giving up her college scholarship to stay home, care for [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), and teach locally so they can keep their home. Later, Mrs. Sowerby reveals that [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) selflessly withdrew his application for the [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) school so [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) could teach there, and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) thanks Hugh when she runs into him.
>

> Mrs. Sowerby remarks to [Thomas](../character/thomas-sowerby.md) that [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) has mellowed. After visiting Obed's grave, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) meets [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) on the hill and thanks him for stepping aside for the school position, leading the two former foes to reconcile and become friends. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns home to [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and later reflects contentedly at her window on her future path.
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) is day-dreaming while studying when Mr. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md) angrily confronts her about her cow escaping into his oat field again. After he leaves in a huff, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) locks the cow away and later discusses the incident and local gossip with [Aunt Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and Mrs. Agatha Sowerby over tea.
>

> Mrs. Sowerby visits [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), gossiping about recent incidents and the influx of newcomers to the area. She questions [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) about her proposed Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) and cautions her against pursuing it, while also mentioning that Nell's acquaintance, [Honora Hollis](../character/honora-hollis.md), will be teaching at [Delford](../codex/places.md#delford).
>

> On their way back from shopping in [Delford](../codex/places.md#delford), [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde chase a Jersey cow out of a neighbor's oat field, and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) impulsively sells the cow to Mr. [Shearer](../character/shearer.md). Upon returning home to [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) discovers her own cow is still in the pen, realizing she mistakenly sold Mr. Pettifer's cow instead. Resigned to face his temper, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) packs a freshly baked nut cake as a peace offering and sets off to confess her mistake to Mr. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md).
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) visits Mr. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md) to confess that she mistakenly sold his Jersey cow instead of her own, offering him compensation or her cow in trade. To her relief, Mr. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md) reacts generously, accepts her cow in exchange, and invites her to stay for tea. After sharing a pleasant evening and discussing the [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns home and tells [Aunt Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) how well the ordeal turned out.
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Odette](../character/odette-pullen.md), and Hugh discuss their differing views on classroom discipline before beginning their upcoming teaching terms. Afterward, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) walks home to [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), avoiding Mrs. Sowerby to instead converse with Mr. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md) about her plan to rule her school with affection. The next morning, a nervous [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) shares her anxieties over breakfast with [Aunt Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md).
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde begin canvassing for the [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), first visiting the Andrew sisters. While [Eliza](../character/eliza-pullen.md) bitterly refuses to donate, Catherine sneaks out to give them two quarters for the hall fund before they visit Daniel Blair.
>

She takes advantage of Lorenzo White's excitement over his new baby boy to secure a large donation. Finally, she attempts to get a contribution from Mr. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md), who turns her down.

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh discuss their experiences teaching and their future ambitions before Hugh departs to run an errand. Afterwards, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) returns from visiting [Mary Joe](../character/mary-joe.md), expressing concern over Mary's failing health and the uncertain future of the Farrow twins. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) successfully convinces [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) to take in the children for the winter out of a sense of duty, offering to handle their sewing.
>

> [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) brings the newly orphaned twins, [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) and [Lucy](../character/lucy.md), back to live at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters). [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) proves to be extremely energetic and prone to mischief, including dropping a caterpillar down Lauretta's dress during church. During a meeting of the [Aid Society](../codex/factions.md#aid-society) at the house, a dripping-wet [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) bursts into the dining room after [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) entices her outside.
>

After [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) is sent to his room, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) talks with him, prompting [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) to confess that he also hid a toad under Thirza's pillow, which [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) secretly removes.

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Mr. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md) debate Mrs. Sowerby's character and discuss the Improvement Society's progress on fixing up the hall. Later, Mrs. Sowerby and the youths discover that [Joshua Tulk](../character/joshua-tulk.md) painted the hall bright blue instead of green due to a mix-up with paint order numbers. Despite the catastrophic outcome, the community rallies behind the [Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers) and blames the [Tulks](../codex/factions.md#tulks) for the mistake.
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) walks home through the woods, chatting with [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md) along the way. Upon arriving at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), she learns from [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) that young [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) has gone missing, sparking a desperate search that eventually leads to finding [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) locked in Mr. Pettifer's toolhouse by [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md). When confronted about his trickery and lying, [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) breaks down in tears, admitting he didn't realize lying was wrong, leading [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) to forgive the lies while determining how to discipline him for locking [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) away.
>

[Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) defends [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), and after going downstairs, she and [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) discuss Robin's mischievous behavior and how best to raise him.

> Suffering from a toothache, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) loses her temper at school, accidentally causing firecrackers to detonate in the stove and later whipping [Anthony Tulk](../character/anthony-tulk.md) for putting a mouse in her desk. Devastated by her loss of composure, she confides in [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) at home. The next morning, Anthony surprisingly shows respect for her actions, which is later confirmed by [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md).

[Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) enthusiastically plans and prepares a elaborate dinner menu for the upcoming visit, while [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) assist with the preparations.

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde spend the morning busily preparing [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) and cooking a lavish meal to welcome Mrs. [Varley](../character/varley.md), but [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) accidentally ruins the lemon pies and gets sent to his room. When Mrs. [Varley](../character/varley.md) and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) fail to arrive, the group sits down to eat without them, only to discover the peas have been over-sweetened by multiple cooks. To make matters worse, as dinner ends, [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) accidentally knocks a heavy shell down the stairs, shattering Miss Pembroke's borrowed platter.

While transferring feathers, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) accidentally applies rug dye to her nose, but Isolde helps her wash it off before they host [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md), Mrs. [Varley](../character/varley.md), and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md) for dinner and a stroll.

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns to teaching school, where [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) reports his classroom antics while [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) is terrified by [Mirabel](../character/mirabel-cotton.md) Cotton's stories of family ghosts. Later, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde take a wrong turn while walking through the autumn woods to a tea invitation and discover [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage), where its owner, Miss Rosalind [Penrose](../character/rosalind-penrose.md), invites them to stay for tea.
>

> During breakfast at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) discuss [Rosalind](../character/rosalind-penrose.md) Penrose's appearance and past engagement, while dealing with Robin's table manners. A month later, a letter arrives revealing that [Richard Farrow](../character/richard-farrow.md) has passed away, leaving a trust fund for the twins so they can remain permanently at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters).
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) walks to [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage) to spend a cozy winter night with Miss Rosalind, who shares the story of her long-ago engagement to [Stephen Stanhope](../character/stephen-stanhope.md) and the prideful misunderstanding that separated them. A month later, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) brings Stephen's son, [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md), to meet Miss Rosalind, and the two quickly bond during a pleasant visit.
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) dismisses school early as a monstrous storm approaches, exactly as [Uncle Zeb](../character/uncle-zeb.md) predicted. She rushes home with [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) and [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) to [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), where they shelter with [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) through a terrifying 45-minute hail storm that devastates crops and shatters windows. Afterward, [John Henry Carter](../character/john-henry-carter.md) arrives to report that lightning struck Mr. Pettifer's home and killed his pet parrot, [Nutmeg](../character/nutmeg.md), prompting [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to visit and offer comfort.
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) comforts Mr. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md) after the storm kills his parrot, [Nutmeg](../character/nutmeg.md). The community assesses the widespread destruction, while [Uncle Zeb](../character/uncle-zeb.md) revels in the exactness of his storm prediction. Hugh visits [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) to recount the panic at the school and discuss the damage with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md).
>

> A stylish older woman arrives at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) looking for [James A](../character/james-a.md). [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md) and reveals to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) that she is his long-estranged wife, [Emily](../character/emily.md). The news quickly spreads through the village, and when [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) visits Mr. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md), she finds his house freshly cleaned and learns that he is secretly glad to have his wife back.
>

Later, Mrs. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md) expresses her gratitude over the paper's note, and Mrs. Sowerby chats with [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) before [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) puts a sleepy [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) to bed.
>

> Following [Thomas](../character/thomas-sowerby.md) Sowerby's death, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) proposes inviting the widowed [Agatha](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) to move into [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) so that [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) can attend [Wexcombe College](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college). [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) resigns from her teaching position, causing her students great dismay, while she and Isolde discuss the upcoming changes in [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley).
>

After sending [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) to bed, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) walks down to [Victoria Island](../codex/places.md#victoria-island) to sit alone and lose herself in peaceful daydreams.

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) settle into college life at [Wexcombe](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college), aided by Cressida Lindsay's social influence while [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) earns respect as Freshman Class president. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) receives a stack of letters from home containing updates from [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) and news from her friends and family, including humorous local stories from Mrs. Sowerby.

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns home to [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) for the [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) holiday, where she is warmly welcomed by Isolde, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), Mrs. Sowerby, [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md), and [Lucy](../character/lucy.md). Before bed, [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) confesses his desire to use a bad word he heard from a hired boy, and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) gently helps him overcome his conflict. On [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) morning, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) receives letters from [Rosalind](../character/rosalind-penrose.md) and Cressida, sharing their news and humorous stories.
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) completes her term at [Wexcombe](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college) while managing persistent suitors, including an unpleasant proposal from [Wilfred Mott](../character/wilfred-mott.md). She receives a letter from her friend [Mabel](../character/mabel-colby.md) proposing that [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md), and [Mabel](../character/mabel-colby.md) lease a house together for the upcoming school year. After searching without success, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) stumble upon a 'To Let' sign on Tabby's Place in [Portmaris](../codex/places.md#portmaris).

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) writes a story titled 'Evadne's Atonement', sharing her process and drafts with Isolde and seeking feedback from Mr. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md). Both offer critiques on her plot, characters, and descriptions, though [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) keeps her writing hidden from Hugh and [Aunt Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md). After mailing the manuscript to two different magazines, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) receives rejections from both and decides to give up her literary ambitions, despite Mr. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md) encouraging her to keep writing about what she knows.
